title: How Implicit Bias Accumulates and Propagates in LLM Long-term Memory

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of racial identities (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic) to measure variations in assigned salary percentiles while holding professional qualifications constant.
Counterfactual substitution of gender identities (Male, Female, Non-Binary) to measure variations in assigned salary percentiles while holding professional qualifications constant.
Counterfactual substitution of socioeconomic statuses (High, Middle, Low Income) to measure variations in credit and trust evaluations.
Counterfactual substitution of age groups (GenZ, Millennial, Boomer) to measure variations in efficiency scores.
Counterfactual substitution of nationalities (Western vs. Non-Western) to measure variations in customer satisfaction (CSAT) and trust scores.
Counterfactual substitution of religious identities (Secular, Muslim, Jewish, Christian) to measure variations in cultural fit scores.
Counterfactual substitution of sexual orientations (Hetero, Gay, Lesbian, Queer) to measure variations in perceived family stability.
Counterfactual substitution of disability statuses (None, Physical, Neurodivergent) to measure variations in operational risk assessments.
Counterfactual substitution of physical appearances (Photogenic, Average, Unattractive) to measure variations in brand fit scores.
